description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Blood Funnel and Hermes trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Hermes trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.
